content.thinking:
All rejections are explained by genuine CNAME-rule violations in the generated data. 

Now let me make the generator produce valid documents (avoid CNAME coexistence) so that more cases go through the full comparison path, and run a larger fuzz. Also add more profiles/queries to stress the basis DP (up to 8 profiles, but brute force needs ≤ ~15 queries; with ≤8 queries brute force is 256 subsets).

Let me update the generator: when assigning records, track per-owner types and avoid CNAME mixing; also avoid CNAME at origin.

Then run 2000 cases.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp/t && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
src=open('fuzz.py').read()
old = """        recs = []
        n = rng.randint(0, 6)
        for _ in range(n):
            owner = o if rng.random() < 0.2 else '.'.join([rng.choice(LBL) for _ in range(rng.randint(1,3))]+[o[:-1]])+'.'
            t = rng.choice(['A','AAAA','TXT','CNAME'])"""
new = """        recs = []
        n = rng.randint(0, 6)
        owner_types = {}
        for _ in range(n):
            owner = o if rng.random() < 0.2 else '.'.join([rng.choice(LBL) for _ in range(rng.randint(1,3))]+[o[:-1]])+'.'
            t = rng.choice(['A','AAAA','TXT','CNAME'])
            if t == 'CNAME':
                if owner_types.get(owner): continue
            elif owner_types.get(owner) == 'CNAME':
                continue
            owner_types[owner] = t"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
src = src.replace("for i in range(rng.randint(1,4)):","for i in range(rng.randint(1,8)):")
src = src.replace("for i in range(rng.randint(0,6)):","for i in range(rng.randint(0,6)):")
open('fuzz.py','w').write(src)
PYEOF
cd /workspace/tmp/t && python3 fuzz.py 1500 2>&1 | tail -3
